title: The functor of points where a module is free at the generic points of the fibres is an fpqc sheaf and limit preserving
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the functor H_p assigning to a base change the property that the pullback of a module is free of rank p at every generic point of every fibre is an fpqc sheaf, and is limit preserving when the module is of finite presentation (statement lines 6178-6186, tag 05MS). The proof has two genuinely different halves: the sheaf half descends local freeness to the limit point through the flat local map of stalks and then has to upgrade a surjection from a free module to an isomorphism by checking the reduction fibre by fibre, using the induction step lemma; the limit preserving half descends the flat locus and its rank stratification to a stage and uses the open images in the base to find a stage at which the condition already holds. The second half is the substance, so the claim is H2.
